name: System Epochs and Serial Date Formats
description: Epoch baselines, counting units (days, seconds, ms), leap year quirks, and arithmetic rules across SAS, Unix, Excel, and SQL engines.
when_to_retrieve: When migrating SAS numeric dates or datetimes to Python, SQL, or Java
When converting Excel serial numbers to calendar dates
When converting integer/float offsets into timestamps
when_not_to_retrieve: When manipulating human-readable ISO-8601 strings without numeric offsets
retrieval_guidance: Distinguish SAS date (unit: days, epoch: 1960-01-01) from SAS datetime (unit: seconds, epoch: 1960-01-01). Mixing days and seconds results in multi-thousand-year offset errors.
